reasons.plausibility: The hypothesis incorrectly assumes a γ′ (L12) phase forms in Al–Co–Cr–Fe–Ni, whereas the well-established phase formation in this system is B2 and/or BCC phases with increasing Al, making the proposed mechanism physically unsound.
reasons.testability: The proposed test is clear and feasible, but it would not falsify the specific mechanistic hypothesis because the predicted γ′ phase is not expected to form, so the test would instead falsify a different, incorrect premise.
reasons.usefulness: The hypothesis is not useful because it is based on a fundamental misunderstanding of the phase equilibria in the Al–Co–Cr–Fe–Ni system, leading researchers down an unproductive path.
